en: Black‑and‑white view of a small European town square or park with flowerbeds and low iron fencing in the foreground. People in early‑20th‑century clothing stand and sit near the paths. Behind the park stand several multi‑story townhouses with ornate facades and shop signs. In the center background rises a tall church tower with a steep spire, clock or blank roundel on the tower face, and a weather vane on top. Trees frame the scene on both sides.
